src/lib/components/RevoGrid.react.js.description: High-performance virtual data grid exposed as a Plotly Dash component.

className.description: CSS class applied to the RevoGrid component host.

style.description: Inline style applied to the RevoGrid component host.

accessible.description: Enables accessibility attributes and keyboard behavior.

additionalData.description: Additional plain JSON data available to grid configuration.

applyOnClose.description: Applies filter changes when the filter popover closes.

autoSizeColumn.description: Enables or configures automatic column sizing.

canFocus.description: Allows the grid to receive focus.

columnTypes.description: Named JSON-safe column type definitions. Function members are unsupported.

columns.description: Column definitions. Function-valued renderers and editors are unsupported.

filter.description: Enables or configures filtering. Function-valued custom filters are unsupported.

frameSize.description: Number of extra virtualized items rendered around the viewport.

noHorizontalScrollTransfer.description: Prevents wheel transfer from horizontal grid scrolling.

pinnedBottomSource.description: Rows pinned to the bottom viewport.

pinnedTopSource.description: Rows pinned to the top viewport.

rowClass.description: CSS class applied to grid rows.

source.description: Main row source. Pass DataFrame data with df.to_dict("records").

trimmedRows.description: Map of trimmed physical row indexes.

afteredit.description: Latest compact afteredit JSON-safe event envelope.

beforefilterapply.description: Latest beforefilterapply notification. Python cannot cancel it synchronously.

eventListeners.description: Other RevoGrid event names to publish through eventData.

eventData.description: Latest JSON-safe event envelope from eventListeners.

syncSourceOnEdit.description: When true, afteredit also updates the complete Dash source property.

setProps.description: Dash callback used to report property changes.
